assertions.name: framework_ansatz_residual_pinned
assertions.source: Bare q·[9]_q·[10]_q at full precision (q₀=1.10998…) lands at α⁻¹=136.8232, residual −1552.7 ppm vs CODATA 137.035999084. Yekutieli h² extraction does NOT close this: T(2,9) vanishes, T(3,5) is already exact in the closed-form Markov trace, and the Markov-trace product itself is ~10⁶ ppm off — so the [n]_q ansatz is NOT the bare Markov trace, and the residual is structural to the [n]_q identification, not a missing h² term.

description: Derive-or-refute: does the exact Markov-trace product for the FSC torus knots T(2,9) and T(3,5) close the ~500 ppm α_EM residual left by the bare q·[9]_q·[10]_q ansatz? Yekutieli h² extraction: T(2,9) vanishes (single generator); T(3,5)'s h² content is already in the closed-form Markov trace via central-full-twist factorisation (Δ₃² = I on (2,1), eigenvalues of σ₁σ₂ are cube roots of unity → χ_(2,1)((σ₁σ₂)⁵) = −1 EXACTLY, independent of q). No fit; no fitting.

yekutieli_h2_status.T35: captured by closed-form Markov trace; the (2,1) cube-root-of-unity contribution is the q-independent piece
